Requirement: Scope of the food safety management system defined and written down
Interested parties and their requirements listed (parents, MoPH, suppliers)
Food safety policy written, signed and displayed in the kitchen
Roles and responsibilities for food safety assigned
Risks and opportunities for the FSMS assessed with actions
Food safety objectives set and tracked (complaints, temp logs)
Team trained on hygiene and allergen handling; records kept
Calibrated thermometers for fridges, freezers and blast chiller
Documented information controlled (versions, who can edit)
Cleaning & sanitation schedule per area, signed daily
Pest control contract and inspection log
Supplier approval list with certificates for every ingredient
Personal hygiene rules: uniforms, handwash stations, illness policy
Water potability tested and recorded
Flow diagram for each product family (puree / finger food / cake)
Hazard analysis per step (biological, chemical, physical, allergen)
CCPs set with critical limits (cook core temp, chill time, cold chain)
Monitoring records for each CCP with corrective actions
Full lot traceability: ingredient lot to batch to order
FEFO stock rotation enforced at picking (earliest expiry first)
Allergen labelling on every pack; nut-aware age programs flagged
Recall / withdrawal procedure written and tested once
Cold-chain delivery: insulated boxes, max transit time defined
Customer complaints reviewed weekly and linked to lots
Internal audit plan - at least one full audit per year
Management review meeting with minutes
Corrective actions tracked to closure with root cause
FSMS updated when menu, suppliers or process change
